stat.title: Sites
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(s.id) as cnt from Site as s left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id

stat.title: Devices
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(d.id) as cnt from Device as d inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join DeviceType as dt on dt.id = d.deviceTypeId inner join DeviceTypeCategory as dc on dc.id = dt.deviceTypeCategoryId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where dc.hasResults = 1

stat.title: Results
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on p.id = s.partnerId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.days = 30
stat.description: The number of results in the last 30 days

stat.title: Contacts
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u

stat.title: Positive Results Notified Rate
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u
stat.description: The percentage of GeneXpert's TB and HIV results that were notified

stat.title: GeneXpert's Positive Results Notified
stat.subTitle: This Month
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(count(r.id), 0) as cnt from Result as r inner join Device as d on d.id = r.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner p on s.partnerId = p.id left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where YEAR(r.endedOn) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) and MONTH(r.endedOn) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE)
stat.sqlForExtra: SELECT IFNULL( ROUND(SUM(ISNULL(n.id) = 0) * 100 / COUNT(*), 0) , 0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN Assay a ON r.assayId = a.id INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.id LEFT JOIN Geography g ON s.geographyId = g.id LEFT JOIN Issue i ON r.id = i.resultId LEFT JOIN IssueType it ON i.issueTypeId = it.id LEFT JOIN Notification n ON i.id = n.issueId WHERE rc.externalid = 'Detected' AND it.externalId = 'ResultReceived' AND a.externalId IN('GxMtbRif', 'GxMtbRifUltra', 'GxHiv1Vl', 'GxHiv1Qual') AND YEAR(r.endedOn) = YEAR(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(r.endedOn) = MONTH(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL -1 MONTH));
stat.description: The percentage of GeneXpert's TB and HIV results that were notified
